description: This file contains unit tests for the GenreStatistics class in a book project. It tests methods related to genre statistics, such as finding the most read, most liked, and least liked genres, using JUnit 5. It utilizes Spring annotations for dependency injection and transactional behavior.

classes.name: GenreStatisticsTest
classes.description: Test suite for the GenreStatistics component, verifying correctness of genre-based statistical computations in a book management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by resetting book data and populating read books before each test.

methods.name: resetBookService
methods.description: Deletes all books from the BookService to reset state.

methods.name: findMostReadGenre
methods.description: Tests that the system correctly identifies the most read genre.

methods.name: findMostLikedGenre
methods.description: Tests that the system correctly identifies the most liked genre.

methods.name: findLeastLikedGenre
methods.description: Tests that the system correctly identifies the least liked genre.

methods.name: saveBook
methods.description: Adds a read book to set up specific test scenarios.
